Hello, 

I searched here in the group for someone who had the same problem and I already managed to solve it!
There was one day that the program started to give this error, as if there were missing files, I tried to install distance 7.1 again but could not execute the installation, so I had to manually extract the files and then it was installed. Once reinstalled, it didn't give any more error messages and I manage to do my analysis! 

Thank you anyway!

Sara
